class.name: CbRules
class.brief_description: A scene's reactions and predictions as lines of text: a rules sheet (a .rules file) instead of one [CbReaction] or [CbPrediction] node each. A Node3D: what a rule adds with no place of its own goes where this node is.
class.description:
Logic is text; what is a place or a thing stays a node. Put a [CbRules] where a [CbReaction] would go and point [member file] at a [code].rules[/code] file of the project. When the scene is used, each action of each rule becomes a [CbReaction] under this node (internal: never saved with the scene), so the director, the guard and the Cue Preview treat them as any other. [codeblock] # A thud where a hit lands, and the barrel glowing while the bat is hot. on melee.hit subject $at at point sound res://assets/sfx/bat_hit.wav volume -6 jitter 0.1 range 40
while melee.hot set Barrel surface_material_override/0:emission_energy_multiplier 4 blend 0.2 [/codeblock] A rule starts with [code]on <event> [if <expression>][/code] or [code]while <expression>[/code]; the lines under it are its settings and its actions (indenting is for the eye). [b]Settings[/b]: [code]subject PATH[/code], [code]side a|b|either[/code], [code]kind KIND[/code], [code]template NAME[/code], [code]delay S[/code], [code]chance P[/code], [code]cooldown S[/code], [code]wait [off][/code] (wait for the server's cue), [code]at point|end|beam|follow|here|PATH [from PATH] [offset X Y Z][/code]. A setting holds for the actions below it, top to bottom, until another line changes it ([code]at here[/code], [code]delay 0[/code], [code]chance 1[/code], [code]cooldown 0[/code], [code]wait off[/code] go back to the defaults); one after the last action is a mistake. [b]Actions[/b]: [code]sound PATH [volume DB] [pitch P] [jitter J] [range M] [bus NAME] [volume_by EXPR][/code]; [code]scene PATH [under PATH] [life S][/code]; [code]play PLAYER ANIMATION [off ANIMATION][/code]; [code]set PATH PROPERTY VALUE [blend S][/code] or [code]set PATH PROPERTY = EXPRESSION[/code]; [code]call PATH METHOD [ARGUMENTS][/code]; [code]shake AMOUNT [time S][/code]; [code]flash rgba(r, g, b, a) [time S][/code]. A value is a number, [code]true[/code], [code]false[/code], [code]rgb(r, g, b)[/code], [code]rgba(r, g, b, a)[/code], [code](x, y, z)[/code], a word or [code]"text"[/code]. [b]Predictions[/b] (a [CbPrediction] each) are rules of their own: [code]predict ACTION as CUE [if EXPRESSION][/code], then [code]cooldown S[/code], [code]held[/code], [code]change FIELD OP NUMBER[/code] (one line each), [code]stance NAME [on LAYER][/code]. [b]Paths[/b] are the reactions' (an anchor: [code]$at[/code], [code]$other[/code], [code]^[/code], [code]^^[/code], [code]$local[/code], [code]$world[/code]), or a plain path from the node this one is under ([code]Barrel[/code]; [code].[/code] is that node), climbing no higher than the scene. [code]#[/code] starts a comment. [b]Mistakes[/b] are said with their line: on the node in the editor, and when the look is published (a name no mod declares too). A rule with one is left out; the rest of the sheet still works. The editor opens [code].rules[/code] files in its script editor.
